title: Source Ledger Bridge: retrieved sources survive native re-derivation

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.36 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow source-ledger bridge patch, so focused regressions plus audit:gold:smoke are the release gate.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on two fresh deployed v0.15.35 EduTool.dev ZIP/log audits saved under verification-output/edutool-audit-loop/20260620T160412Z and 20260620T170412Z.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: Two fresh deployed v0.15.35 EduTool.dev audits showed retrieved OpenAlex/source-finder resources in the digest while the exported source ledger collapsed to one ambiguous OpenLibrary row; the tracked roadmap records that evidence so CI can verify the release from a clean checkout.
proofCommands: Manual EduTool.dev ZIP/log audits summarized in docs/V0.15.36_SOURCE_LEDGER_BRIDGE_ROADMAP.md from local verification-output/edutool-audit-loop/20260620T160412Z/ and 20260620T170412Z/

claims.summary: Native stable-id re-derivation preserves unmatched source-backed resources and relinks session-backed rows to the matching session section.
The source ledger recovers provider/title/URL/license/snippet rows from sourceFinderMiniShard when graph resource cells are sparse.
The source-thinness and review-row checks remain armed; this release improves evidence retention without weakening the grader or claiming full atom-level source relevance.

carryForward.next: Build a real ResearchSession planner that researches course concepts once, caches a trusted ledger, maps retrieved source rows to CurriculumV1 atoms, and compiles many deliverables without browsing per artifact.
Check whether each atom's sourceRefs are topically relevant to that atom rather than only structurally present.
